name: Alpen-Campingplatz
beschreibung: The **Alpen-Campingplatz** is located in **Lenggries**, **Tirol**, **Austria**. The **location** of the campsite is on the outskirts of the village, right by the valley road. The **atmosphere** is shaped by the surrounding mountains and alpine flora. The area provides access to marked **hiking trails** and, during the winter season, to the **ski resorts** of the region. The **facilities** include sanitary buildings, power hookups at the pitches, and a communal lounge. Guests can expect a stay in **nature**, with views of the surrounding peaks.
